title: ALLOW, NEEDS YOU, DENY.
hook: Three words decide what our AI is allowed to do with your money.
thesis: FYD's action policy returns ALLOW, NEEDS_OWNER, or DENY, bound to tenant, actor, capability, argument digest, expiry, and budget. The system earns autonomy by consequence: routine work flows, and anything that spends your money or carries real risk comes to you first. This post teaches the autonomy gradient in one compact explanation.

verified: Action policy returns ALLOW, NEEDS_OWNER, or DENY bound to tenant, actor, capability, argument digest, expiry, and budget (FYD ten-day directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
UNKNOWN is a first-class effect state: a timed-out call is never blindly retried (directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
